scope: Unbounded symbolic edge IDs/typed rows and required/native relation-type sets. Complete native scope superset, actual old/new-row correspondence, continuously held cut and faithful one-row transitions imply arbitrary one-step required-projection preservation; stable-scope finite-history induction assumes those premises at every step. Monotonic extension preserves earlier required coverage, not earlier baseline equality for newly added facts. Truncate has a separate statement guard. Does not derive SQL/trigger/savepoint/driver refinement, original authenticated dependency membership, installed source/ACL closure, whole authorization, business-write authorization, complete atomic effects or final disclosure.
